display_name: PU-12M battery command post (9С482М): plotting board
status: System data for the battery command post's plotting board (simcore/pu12.hpp, roadmap 7.1). Every value cited.
notes: The board is the PU-12M's air-situation map: the plotter writes on it, behind the glass, what the regiment's radar battery reads out on the air-picture net, and the battery commander reads the targets' azimuth and range off it (rwd_mb3 pu12e; flak11 PU12-1; pvo_bu_x_1984 art. 23). It reaches beyond the IT-45's 100 km: the battery's early warning. Targets are designated to the vehicles by voice, azimuth and range (flak11). The board is the post's: a launcher's crew knows only the designations it hears. When the player's vehicle is the post, the plotter's work sets the cadence (command_post.hpp); this file's period is the board as a separate early-warning source (c2_sources.hpp). docs/research/PLOTTING_BOARD_2026-10.md.

update_period_s.source: samsim_osa p20 (the location of the target is updated every minute, and a timestamp is noted: 01, 02, ...); bguir_tsp (fixes timed in minutes of the hour, up to two minutes between reports); narodna_armiya_2018 (1-2 min)
update_period_s.notes: SAM Simulator's minute; the written sources give one to two minutes per target, so one minute is the quick end.

max_range_m.source: samsim_osa p20 (range circles at 50, 100, 150 and 200 km from the battery)
max_range_m.notes: Taken as the board's extent; how far the regiment's picture really reaches depends on its radars (P-19, P-40), not modelled.

radar_battery_number.source: samsim_osa p20 (target 6201: '62' is the tactical number of the radar battery that detected it first)
radar_battery_number.notes: The manual's example number; any two-digit tactical number would do.

navigation_error_deg.source: flak11 (PU-12M navigation errors up to 5 degrees and 3 km)
navigation_error_deg.notes: Drawn once per board, uniformly up to this much (the distribution is a sam3d estimate).

designation_range_m.source: samsim_osa p21 (the crew waits until the target track approaches the 50 km range circle, then starts)
designation_range_m.notes: Targets inside this range of the battery are designated to the vehicle by voice.

operator_delay_s.source: estimate (the same as the R-123M's operator delay in data/em/osa_ak.json)

message_s.source: estimate (one designation read out: number, azimuth, range; the same as the R-123M's message time in data/em/osa_ak.json); flak11 (designations by voice radio, azimuth and range, to each vehicle)

pass_on_s.source: estimate (the vehicle commander passing the designation to his crew)

navigation_error_m.source: flak11 (PU-12M navigation errors up to 5 degrees and 3 km)
navigation_error_m.notes: Drawn once per board, uniformly over a disc of this radius (sam3d estimate).
